name: slack-catch-up
description: Catches you up on your team chat workspace: for the channels and direct messages you are in, since your last catch-up in this conversation (first time: the last 24 hours, or a window you name, 1 to 7 days), it shows per channel the messages that mention you and the decisions made first, each with the exact quote, who said it and a link, then up to 3 short highlights. Channels with mentions or decisions come first; @channel broadcasts are counted, not treated as personal mentions. Up to 12 channels and 5 direct message conversations per run, and it says which ones it could not read. Read-only: it never posts, replies, reacts, marks anything read or joins channels. Without a chat connection it summarizes pasted channel text.

skills.name: Chat catch-up
skills.description: Per-channel catch-up of your chat workspace since your last run: mentions of you and decisions first (verbatim quotes, who, links), then up to 3 highlights per channel, with totals and coverage notes. Read-only.
